clue.text: Information on summit in Blair's bureaucratic language?

parts.note: news is information about recent events
a peak is the summit of a mountain

explanation.surface: Seems to ask about intelligence briefings at a summit conducted in Tony Blair's civil-service jargon.
explanation.walkthrough: The Blair is not Tony but Eric Blair, the real name of George Orwell, who coined the term in Nineteen Eighty-Four.
explanation.definitionFit: Orwell's invented official dialect of euphemism and propaganda is the language in question, hence the question mark.

clue.text: End of game inventor set up

indicators.note: in a down entry, set up means the word is written upwards, from bottom to top

parts.note: Thomas Edison was the inventor of the phonograph and light bulb

explanation.surface: A games designer has rigged the ending.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is the rugby referee's call at the final whistle.
explanation.definitionFit: In rugby union the referee's call ending the match was traditionally this phrase.

clue.text: Ceremony in outskirts of Windsor for author

indicators.note: the ceremony word goes in between the two outer letters
outskirts are the outer edges, so the first and last letters

parts.note: a rite is a ceremony

explanation.surface: An author attends a ceremony near Windsor.
explanation.definitionFit: An author is someone who writes books, a synonym for one who writes.

clue.text: I, pampered at sea? A fanciful hope

indicators.note: at sea means confused or all over the place, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A spoilt person imagines a life of luxury on a cruise.
explanation.definitionFit: A notion originally linked to opium smoking, it now means an unrealistic hope.

clue.text: George's gun, one used in conspiracy

parts.note: an automatic is a self-loading gun

indicators.note: the numeral word is used inside the conspiracy word

parts.note: a plot is a conspiracy
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: George's firearm was used in a plot, like a conspiracy thriller.
explanation.walkthrough: George is aviators' slang for the automatic flight-control system; the 's is 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Pilots nicknamed the device that flies the aircraft unaided George, hence the slang definition.

clue.text: Braved winds bravely, say

indicators.note: winds as in twists about, so the letters of the word before are wound into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone braved the winds in a courageous manner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'winds' looks like the gales being braved, but it is the verb signalling an anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: Bravely is an example of a part of speech modifying verbs, hence 'say'.

clue.text: Greek character, duke, unexpectedly late

indicators.note: unexpectedly tells us the letters of the next word turn up in an unforeseen order

explanation.surface: A Greek nobleman arrives later than anyone expected.
explanation.definitionFit: The fourth letter of the Greek alphabet is a character in that alphabet.

clue.text: Graphically detailed clip playing during departure

indicators.note: during places the jumbled clip within the departure word

parts.note: an exit is a departure

indicators.note: playing means fooling about, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A vivid film clip is shown as people leave.
explanation.definitionFit: Explicit material shows or describes everything in graphic, unreserved detail.

clue.text: Mark engaging in a bit of banter

indicators.note: engaging means holding or taking in, so the other letters go inside

parts.note: a badge is a distinguishing mark or emblem

explanation.surface: Mark joins in some light-hearted teasing.
explanation.definitionFit: Badinage is light, playful exchange of teasing remarks.

clue.text: Fine delicate instrument: it may reveal cause of crash

definitions.text: it may reveal cause of crash

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for fine on pencils
light means delicate, as in a light touch
a recorder is a woodwind instrument

explanation.surface: A finely made delicate instrument whose readings can explain an accident.
explanation.walkthrough: 'instrument' suggests a gauge, but it is the woodwind recorder.
explanation.definitionFit: The black box on an aircraft logs data that investigators use to establish why a plane came down.

clue.text: Turned legs on favourite piece

indicators.note: turned means the word for legs is read the other way round

parts.note: pins is slang for legs
a pet is a favourite, as in teacher's pet

explanation.surface: Turned table legs set onto a favourite piece of furniture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' is a link word putting the second piece after the first.
explanation.definitionFit: A snippet is a small piece or fragment of something.

clue.text: Leaf from notebook taken by girl

parts.note: Lily is a girl's name
a pad is a notebook of tear-off sheets

explanation.surface: A girl has torn a leaf out of a notebook.
explanation.definitionFit: The floating leaf of a water lily is one specific kind of leaf, not a page.

clue.text: Great fear about being caught by old man

indicators.note: one piece is held inside the other, as if caught and held by it

parts.note: old man is slang for father, dad
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: Someone is terrified of being caught out by their father.
explanation.definitionFit: Dread is intense fear or apprehension of something to come.

clue.text: Russian aircraft helping removal from one country to another

definitions.text: removal from one country to another

parts.note: the MiG is a Russian fighter jet
a ration is a portion or helping of food

explanation.surface: A Russian plane assisting people who are relocating abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: Migration is the movement of people settling in a different country or region.

clue.text: Beaten hollow, resigned position

parts.note: someone who resigned left the job
standing is position or rank

explanation.surface: A soundly defeated person stepped down from their post.
explanation.definitionFit: To be outpaced so completely that one seems not to have moved is to be beaten hollow.

clue.text: Mend set eccentric American brought in? I can't afford not to

indicators.note: the American abbreviation is brought inside the jumbled letters
eccentric means odd or irregular, so the letters are disordered

explanation.surface: An odd American told to fix a set protests that it is unavoidable.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverb says when the devil drives you, necessity compels action, hence no alternative.

clue.text: Ploughman strangles her heartlessly in film full of suspense?

indicators.note: strangles means grips around the neck, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: a tiller is one who tills the soil

indicators.note: heartlessly removes the central letter of the word her

explanation.surface: A farmhand murders a woman in a suspense film.
explanation.definitionFit: A suspense movie, typically of crime or espionage, keeps viewers on edge.

clue.text: What may be put by mother on table at first?

definitions.text: What may be put by mother on table at first?

parts.note: to place something is to put it
ma is a familiar word for mother

indicators.note: at first takes the opening letter of the word table

explanation.surface: Asks what mother lays on the table before the meal.
explanation.definitionFit: A mat set under each diner's plate is laid on the dining table first.

clue.text: Sacred fish? Wow!

parts.note: holy means sacred
the mackerel is a sea fish

explanation.surface: An exclamation at the sight of a revered fish.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is a jocular exclamation of astonishment, just like wow.

clue.text: Bank employee, one who counts

definitions.meaning: a cashier who deals with customers at a bank counter

explanation.surface: A cashier described as someone who adds up money.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a bank cashier and anyone tallying votes or items.

clue.text: Indefinite number leaving English city at once

indicators.note: leaving means the letter for the number departs from the city name

parts.note: Preston is a city in Lancashire
n is the mathematical symbol for an unspecified number

explanation.surface: A vague number of people quit an English city immediately.
explanation.definitionFit: Presto means immediately, as in a conjuror's hey presto.

clue.text: Noticing changes by Oscar, under an assumed name

indicators.note: the letters of the first word undergo changes, being reordered

parts.note: Oscar is O in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone notices that Oscar is travelling under a false identity.
explanation.definitionFit: Travelling incognito means concealing one's identity, often by using a false name.

clue.text: Rex in profit? A very small amount

indicators.note: in places the king's letter inside the profit word

parts.note: a gain is a profit
Rex, Latin for king, is abbreviated R

explanation.surface: Asks whether the king is making money, and suggests only a trifle.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny particle or trace of something, as in a hint of truth.

clue.text: Control the movement of ox

definitions.meaning: to guide or direct a vehicle or animal
a young castrated male bovine raised for beef

explanation.surface: An instruction to guide an ox.
explanation.definitionFit: One word both means to guide a course and names a bullock, a castrated ox.

clue.text: Rheumatic pain results in climber not starting

indicators.note: not starting means the first letter of the word is left off

parts.note: plumbago is a climbing plant with blue flowers

explanation.surface: Back pain caused by mountaineering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'climber' suggests a mountaineer, but it is a climbing plant, plumbago, which loses its P.
explanation.definitionFit: Lumbago is rheumatic or muscular pain in the lower back.

clue.text: Chap that can get us a gold?

indicators.note: the letters can get, that is be turned into, a man's name when rearranged

explanation.surface: Asks which man could win a gold medal for the team.
explanation.definitionFit: Douglas is a man's name, and chap is a general word for a man.

clue.text: Ordinary seaman, seaman knocked over in gale, initially

indicators.note: knocked over in a down clue sense here means the sailor word is turned round

parts.note: tar is an old word for a sailor

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of the word gale

explanation.surface: A lowly sailor and a colleague both bowled over in a storm.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Royal Navy a rating is a sailor without a commission, an ordinary seaman.

clue.text: Coming out of speaker, I love Handel's Messiah, for example

parts.note: an orator is a public speaker
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A speaker declares a love of Handel's best-known choral work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coming out of' is a link word saying the answer is built from what follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Messiah is the classic example of a large sacred choral work for soloists, chorus and orchestra.
